2020/21.group_format: Leagues A-C: four groups of four; League D: one group of four and one group of three; double round-robin within each group.

league_phase_rules.league_a_qualification: Each group winner qualifies for the Nations League Finals (two semi-finals, third-place match and final).
league_phase_rules.promotion: Group winners in Leagues B, C and D are promoted.
league_phase_rules.direct_relegation: Bottom teams in Leagues A and B are relegated.
league_phase_rules.league_c_relegation: Four fourth-placed League C teams enter two-legged play-outs; two lose and are relegated. The original 2020/21 play-outs were rescheduled to March 2022 and had a later away-goals amendment; those four matches are not in this 512-match target window.

tiebreak.operationalization_gap: The frozen match source has no disciplinary-card totals. Exact positions remain unresolved where an applicable tie reaches that criterion; the dataset never sorts tied teams arbitrarily.

2022/23.group_format: Leagues A-C: four groups of four; League D: one group of four and one group of three; double round-robin among eligible participants.

league_phase_rules.league_a_qualification: Each group winner qualifies for the Nations League Finals.
league_phase_rules.promotion: Group winners in Leagues B, C and D are promoted.
league_phase_rules.direct_relegation: Bottom teams in Leagues A and B are relegated.
league_phase_rules.league_c_relegation: The target evaluation includes the single two-legged Lithuania-Gibraltar play-out in March 2024; the 2024/25 participation count differs from earlier editions because Russia was excluded. Do not infer a second tie from the general four-fourth-place format.

tiebreak.rule_reference: 2022/23 Regulations, Article 15 (official regulation attachment was not available as a stable local source during this build)
tiebreak.operationalization_gap: No exact tied-team rank or boundary state is emitted for this edition until the edition-specific regulation text and all required tie-break inputs are frozen.

euro_2024_qualification.note: The Nations League supplied group-winner inputs to a separate EURO 2024 play-off selection process; EURO qualification outcomes are outside this 512-match source and are not represented as Nations League qualification state.

2024/25.group_format: Leagues A-C: four groups of four; League D: two groups of three; double round-robin within each group.

league_phase_rules.league_a_qualification: Top two from each League A group enter two-legged quarter-finals; winners enter the final tournament.
league_phase_rules.promotion: Group winners in Leagues B, C and D are promoted.
league_phase_rules.direct_relegation: Bottom teams in Leagues A and B are directly relegated.
league_phase_rules.league_c_relegation: The two lowest-ranked fourth-placed League C teams are directly relegated; the other two fourth-placed teams play the two League D runners-up in two-legged C/D ties scheduled after this target block.
league_phase_rules.promotion_relegation_playoffs: League A third-placed teams play League B runners-up; League B third-placed teams play League C runners-up; two-legged ties.
league_phase_rules.league_d_schedule_note: Each D team plays four group matches; the calendar also contains two friendlies per League D team. Friendlies are not counted in Nations League group standings.

tiebreak.operationalization_gap: No disciplinary-card totals are present in the frozen match source. Tied ranks remain unresolved when required criteria are missing.
